result.description: A mezcal producer from San Luis Potosí came to us with a brand called Xantolo and asked for a complete renewal. The product was good. The brand looked childish and cheap, dressed in the Day of the Dead the way a movie would dress it. He wanted something that could compete in a demanding market with a daring presence, and keep the elegance of how mezcal is made.
result.title: Alma Brava

result.description: Ando is a berry-flavored gummy made to prevent and ease alcohol flush, also known as Asian flush. The company is in Brooklyn. Its founders, Peter Czepiga and Ray Margono, met as college freshmen. Ray is Indonesian and had lived with the flush his whole adult life. In 2023, before their first production run, they came to us for a brand that made health feel joyful.
result.title: Ando

result.description: Fernando Ramirez started Angeles after a long stretch of stomach pain no doctor could explain. Herbal cleansing protocols worked where the visits had not. The brand grew fast, burned him out, and lost its customers when he renamed it away from an extreme niche. He came to Atla with a large audience that no longer answered, and one ask: "It isn't performing well. I know it could be doing way better."
result.excerpt: Wellness has a rhythm. So does this brand.
result.title: Angeles Wellness

result.description: Create was an AI app builder from San Francisco. You typed what you wanted and it came back as a working product, built with code. The company had been underestimated. Some early users had a bad experience, bigger rivals took the attention, and a launch date was already on the calendar. The brand had to be ready before it.
result.title: Anything AI

result.description: Atla's own brand identity — a visual system built for a cross-border design practice operating between the US and Latin America.
result.title: Atla

result.description:
Baristio was designed to feel more than a café.

We built an identity that blends craft, warmth, and everyday ritual. A visual language that moves between packaging, space, and experience
 without losing coherence.

The wordmark carries presence and familiarity, while the system extends through simple, intentional elements that feel tactile and lived-in.

Nothing overdesigned. Nothing forced.

Just a brand that feels natural in the hands, 
on the table, and inside the space.
result.title: Baristio

result.description: Bond&Bloom is an Atla case study focused on brand identity execution.
result.title: Bond&Bloom

result.description: Bovi Health sells grass-fed beef colostrum and beef organ capsules. Its founders are Shannon Berg, a former college athlete, and Colson Myers, who has trained all his life, and their own line for the company is that health should be simple. They came to Atla at the end of 2024 with products made in the USA by a contract manufacturer and asked for the brand, the packaging and a site to sell from.
result.title: Bovi Health

result.description: A name and a house of color for a kids' creative space in Monterrey.
result.title: Casa Colora

result.description: Castro Capital invests in real estate development in San Luis Potosí. Its co-founders, Moisés and Sebastián Castro Martín del Campo, wanted the firm to be an ally to clients building commercial property, someone to help them make the best choices along the way. In 2021 they asked us for an identity to match that ambition.
result.title: Castro Capital

result.description: Brand identity for a wellness company — visual system, logo, and brand collateral built around intentional, mindful care.
result.title: Conscious Care Co

result.description: A heritage leather house from Upstate New York, rebuilt for the way it sells today.
result.title: Hanks Leather

result.description: Huémac, from Querétaro, set out to be a platform for outdoor experiences: one place to book adventures with the best guides and companies, with safety and trust built in. Its audience ran from the young and adventurous to families and to travellers who wanted the softest version of the outdoors. In 2021 it came to us for a strategy and an identity.
result.title: Huémac

result.description: Mundã is a project of vacation and long-stay homes in La Saladita, on the coast of Guerrero, Mexico. Its full name is Mundã, Aldea del Mar, a village by the sea. The brand had to sell a way of living there, close to the waves and to the neighbors, on posters, on paper and on the wall at the entrance. We made it in 2022.
result.title: Mundã

result.description: Oxylife is oxygenated water in a can, produced in Prague and imported into the United Arab Emirates. Suhail Alameri brought it to us in 2021. He described it as the most stable oxygenated water in the world, sealed in a patented can coated on the inside. When we started, the brand still had no settled name.
result.title: Oxylife

result.description: Pathize Health builds an app for people who live with energy-limiting conditions such as Long COVID, ME/CFS and POTS. It reads data from wearables like Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin and Polar, and helps each person pace the day against a personal limit. In 2023 the team came to us on a referral from the founder of Peachy, with a website relaunch close behind.
result.title: Pathize Health

result.description: Pax & Beneficia opened in Las Colinas in 2019 and grew across Dallas-Fort Worth, roasting its own beans. The name means peace and blessings, and the cafés are built on it: a guest is an honored visitor. The company sells roasted coffee and handcrafted syrups online as well as over the counter. A brand existed, and it had fallen behind the mission.
result.title: Pax & Beneficia

result.description: Peachy is a healthcare startup built for patients, founded by Lex Oiler, a designer who became a founder. In 2022 the team came to us after trying to brand the company themselves. Lex put the problem in one sentence: "I had no idea branding for my startup would end up being the hardest part of my job."
result.title: Peachy Patients

result.description: Rebrand for Persona, the personalized vitamin pioneer: identity, packaging and campaign system built around one idea, only one you.
result.title: Persona

result.description: PuppyPy makes silicone holders that clip a tracking tag onto a dog's collar. In 2022 its founder, Gilad Rom, was renaming and rebuilding the company, then called Huan, to come back to market with a product that had already proved itself. We took it on that spring, as the studio was starting to work with clients in the United States.
result.title: PuppyPy

result.description: Playful brand identity and packaging system for a premium dog food brand with character-driven illustration and bold shelf presence.
result.title: Reggie

result.description: Acre is a resort and farm in San José del Cabo. Its restaurant holds a Michelin Green Star. In the empty center of a circular permaculture garden, the owners were running an open-fire dinner as a pop-up: private buyouts, winemaker dinners, a dark sky above. They called it Rústico. The season was starting and it needed a brand. Cam Watt, the owner, wrote the brief himself: "We want to create an 'experience' or a 'memory'."
result.excerpt: An identity for dinners under the stars.
result.title: Rústico

result.description:
Sexto Abismo was never meant to sit quietly on a shelf.

Inspired by the surreal landscapes of La Huasteca Potosina and Mexican surrealism, this gin was designed as an invitation to step beyond the expected. Not just to mix a cocktail, but to enter another dimension.

We built a world that feels elegant, mysterious, and cinematic. Deep colors. Luxury details. A narrative that blurs the line between reality and imagination.

The bottle becomes an object of curiosity.
The experience becomes ritual.

Sexto Abismo is not just a spirit.
It is a descent into the unreal.

Because the most memorable brands  do not just exist.
They transport.
result.title: Sexto Abismo

result.description: Shop Latinx is a marketplace for Latino brands in beauty, fashion and lifestyle, founded by Brittany Chavez to give those brands visibility in the North American market. It started as a fashion brand and, as we wrote at the time, it lacked the folklore of the culture it served. In 2022 Brittany brought it to us to rebrand it without falling into stereotypes.
result.title: Shop Latinx

result.description: Carlos Alvarado built Tequila Unido alone. Born in Eagle Pass, Texas, with grandparents from Guadalajara and a father who sang mariachi, he calls himself "tejano jalisciense." He registered the name, partnered with a family distillery in Arandas founded in 1915, carried samples by bus to Dallas distributors, and came to us with a symbol, a bottle and a blue label. The brand had to be clarified and kept.
result.excerpt: We refined a legacy without losing its soul.
result.title: Tequila Unido

result.description: The Branding Academy is José Pablo's weekly newsletter for founders and the people who run brands. It was named at the end of 2025 and runs on Substack. It began as a reply on Instagram: comment academy, and he sends you a branding strategy every week. The identity treats the newsletter as a school: a seal, and a row of bound books in pastel cloth.
result.title: The Brand Academy

result.description: Hospitality brand identity for a Bali-based hotel and restaurant concept — refined, travel-forward visual system with editorial sensibility.
result.title: The Bridge

result.description: A quiet-luxury identity for a stylist who dresses founders.
result.title: The Curated Outfit

result.description: The Internet Empires is an Atla case study focused on brand identity execution.
result.title: The Internet Empires

result.description: TigreTigre is a sushi and sake restaurant on Avenida Chapultepec in San Luis Potosí, opened by José Pablo and his partners in 2023. The pitch fits on a sticker: after-office sake and food. Japanese comfort plates made with good ingredients, cocktails and premium sake, a place to land when the day ends. The brand was made before the doors opened.
result.title: TigreTigre

result.description: Torre Avancer is an office tower on Avenida Chapultepec in San Luis Potosí, one of the holdings of Grupo Avancer, a company with businesses in flavors and fragrances, finance, real estate and hotels. The building came before the brand. Its irregular geometry was drawn to recall the semi-desert around the city, and the tower had already won awards when the owners asked us for its identity.
result.title: Torre Avancer

result.description: A new vitamin brand for women, named, drawn and packed before its first order.
result.title: Vyv

result.description: WeLove is an Atla case study focused on brand identity execution.
result.title: WeLove
